title: Nutritious Silky French Bread Toast
description: A quick-fix French dish featuring toasted white bread with a rich umami flavor, perfect for a snack or light meal, and friendly to sugar-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter each slice of bread on both sides.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle grated cheese over the bread slices.
Drizzle chicken broth over the cheese.
Sprinkle dried thyme, salt, and black pepper over the bread.
Mince garlic and sprinkle it over the bread.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until it is toasted and crispy.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the toasted bread warm and enjoy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
